dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $(M,\prec)$ be an ordered graph with maximum degree $1$. Then the class of $(M,\prec)$-free ordered graphs is $\chi$-bounded.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture on ordered graphs arises as a sufficient condition for proving that certain tournament classes are $\operatorname{\overrightarrow{\chi}}$-bounded, via the correspondence between backedge graphs and $\chi$-boundedness established in the paper. It follows from Property 4.10 that Conjecture 4.11 would imply results about $\operatorname{\overrightarrow{\chi}}$-binding tournaments.
